newsitem.title: SWEDEN: Ericsson pulls Swedish shares ahead at close.
newsitem.headline: Ericsson pulls Swedish shares ahead at close.

text.p: Swedish share prices ended slightly higher on Friday as falls curbed the effects of three percent gain in telecoms group LM Ericsson.
The general index rose 0.28 percent to 3,179.27 in healthy turnover totalling 4.5 billion crowns.

Ericsson rose 11 crowns to 364 after touching an all-time high of 371.5 during the session. Most of the gains were a movement to match advances in New York but were also because of a correction from profit-taking on Thursday, one broker said.
Some players moved away from traditional cyclicals in favour of the high-tech stock, a broker said.
Tools and specialty metals maker Sandvik fell 11 crowns to 250 and engineering group Atlas Copco slid seven crowns to 220.
"There were many who sold shares in order to buy Ericsson," one broker said.
Shares in car safety equipment maker Autoliv ALIV.ST were expected to be volatile ahead of its half-year results due at 1330 GMT on Monday.
